issue_request: FHIR-40704 is an Applied/Persuasive Vocab change request to tidy the valueset-expression extension definition by replacing the broken final clause about a server processing the value set with wording that the ValueSet definition (compose) can only be evaluated by a system that understands the expression syntax.
initial_application: The core FHIR source moved the valueset-expression extension definition out of core before the Jira was applied: core commit dd468d4f17 removed source/valueset/structuredefinition-extension-valueset-expression.xml. The Jira was then applied in HL7/fhir-extensions PR #120, where commit d97f79ca updated StructureDefinition.description in input/definitions/ValueSet/StructureDefinition-valueset-expression.xml.
additional_context: The current core build has no active valueset-expression StructureDefinition source. source/fhir.ini lists active extension spreadsheets but not this ValueSet extension, and source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml only links to the Extension Pack while already using the approved system/evaluation concept. The current Extension Pack source and CI page show the corrected top description but still expose the old broken wording in the differential root ElementDefinition.definition/formal table tooltip.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the core combined branch. No core source was changed because any remaining source cleanup belongs in HL7/fhir-extensions.
